title: Epigenetic insights into extreme longevity in the world's oldest terrestrial animal, Jonathan.
snippet: Aldabra giant tortoises () are exceptionally long-lived. We sequenced the genome and methylome of Jonathan, a 194-year-old Aldabra, to explore the molecular basis of his longevity. title: SLC39-driven zinc influx orchestrates pleiotropic tumor-immune system cross-talk to establish immune suppression in colorectal cancer.
snippet: Tumor metabolic programs shape immune evasion; however, the mechanism by which nutrient-transport systems rewire tumor-immune cell interactions remains unknown.
